    Arrows and their representatives #

    An arrow i → j is a pair with e_j R e_i ⊄ R² (Arr). A choice of representatives ρ i j ∈ e_j R e_i \ R² (Valid) spans the radical: every y ∈ e_j R is a combination of ρ i j · w (mem_span_right), and every y ∈ R e_j of w · ρ j k (mem_span_left).
